'''James Canova''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2000 Seattle tournament]] on 5 February 2000 with ISB docking bay drain with scanning crews and Tosche tech with Harvest, according to Charles Hickey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d231">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-07-lake-city-washinton-feb-5th-00d231/ lake-city-washinton-feb-5th-00], DeckTech (Charles "Teacher" Hickey, 7 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-07-lake-city-washinton-feb-5th-00d231/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
